paragraphs: 3-GIS is an enterprise software company whose customers are telecom, electric, and gas organizations that plan, build, manage, and maintain complex infrastructure networks. The software is built for telecom and utility networks, turning spatial, asset, and operational data into a more accurate view of critical infrastructure.

For telecommunications customers it keeps a connected network record for planning, designing, building, documenting, and managing fiber and copper networks. On the utility side it drives Esri Utility Network workflows with tools for editing, tracing, validation, versioning, map production, and data quality. Separate tooling handles third-party pole attachment requests, permits, make-ready coordination, records, communications, compliance support, and billing inputs.

The about page dates the company's combination of GIS expertise and industry software to 2006. Staff are described as software developers, GIS specialists, telecom and utility experts, implementation consultants, support professionals, and customer success leaders. A published case study describes Oman Broadband needing to move to a modern, GIS-based asset management solution as its previous system neared end of life. An events page lists where the team will be exhibiting, speaking, sponsoring, or attending next.
